q=quotes.copy()
q['name']=q.vendor.map(names)
q['risky']=q.risk_flags.apply(lambda f: len([x for x in f if x in('SHELF_FAIL','COA_EXPIRED','COA_CONFLICT','CLAIM_CONTRADICTED','WITHHELD','LATE','SPACE_CLASH')])>0)
q['safe']=q.cleared_questionnaire & ~q.not_quoted & ~q.risky
rows=[]
for r,g in q.groupby('rm_code'):
    rows.append((r,g.material.iloc[0],len(g),int(g.safe.sum()),int(g.cleared_questionnaire.sum()),'; '.join(f"{a}:{','.join(map(str,k+f))}" for a,k,f in zip(g.name,g.knockouts,g.risk_flags))))
result=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['rm','material','quotes','safe','cleared','why'])
